-118.44480,34.05880.name: CMD Fertility
-118.44480,34.05880.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

0.26168,51.14100.name: Care Fertility Tunbridge Wells

0.26168,51.14100.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

76.97000,8.49300.state: Thycaud Post, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram - 695 014, Kerala, India, India
76.97000,8.49300.desc: A BSL4 laboratory, planned. Run by Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (RGCB). It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. Operational or announced: Announced 2020. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

-73.97600,40.75800.name: OrbiMed
-73.97600,40.75800.desc: The largest investment firm dedicated solely to healthcare, holding positions across therapeutics, devices and diagnostics worldwide. A fund of this size and focus shapes which diseases attract company formation at all — and a condition with few patients in wealthy countries does not attract it, however many people it affects elsewhere.

2.37200,48.84100.name: GenSight Biologics — optogenetic vision restoration
2.37200,48.84100.desc: Uses an engineered virus to put a light-sensitive algal protein into retinal cells, restoring partial vision in a blind patient in 2021. An organism’s gene, delivered by another organism, changing what a human nervous system can detect — the clearest existing case of engineering a new sense rather than repairing an old one.
